name: count severities across several rolling date bands
definition: for each severity total the lines falling within rolling today/7-day/30-day/month-to-date buckets relative to a reference date
failure_mode: changed reference date or boundary off-by-one shifts bucket membership

name: craft an html file that still executes javascript after a sanitizing filter
definition: produce an HTML document that, after being through a given JavaScript-stripping filter, still routes code to invoke a browser-side automatic alert dialog.
failure_mode: the filter removes all executable JS and no alert appears
